summary_for_children: Al-Qari'ah describes the Day in words: people like scattered moths and mountains like fluffed wool. Heavy good deeds bring a pleasing life.
environment_concept: A night path where moths flutter and scatter around lamps (101:4), and a field of hills with heaps of fluffed wool beside them (101:5). These are only the Quran's comparisons, shown as everyday things: the Day of 101:1-3, the scales and the Fire are not pictured. No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: Lamp posts with fluttering moths, heaps of fluffed wool at the foot of round hills.

primary_mechanic.text: Gather moths to a lantern at dusk and reflect on lightness and weight of deeds (101:4-9, symbolic, no scales of the Hereafter).

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Great Striking Event
story_library.children_narration: Surah Al-Qari'ah describes the tremendous Day of Judgment. It uses powerful images to remind us that our actions will be weighed. Our good deeds matter, and we should make thoughtful choices.

world_idea.title: The Balance of Good Actions
world_idea.description: Explore a symbolic balance-themed environment with activities involving kindness and responsibility. Do not depict the actual scales of the Hereafter.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
story_library.rule_conflicts_resolved: The scales of the Hereafter are not shown. The moths come from 101:4's image of the Day; this is a nature activity, labelled.
